formula_observations: OIL vs SILICONE: top of list is Isododecane #1, Dimethicone #2, Dimethiconol #3 (volatile hydrocarbon + silicone carrier = the 'dry oil' feel). Plant oils begin at #4: Coconut oil #4, then marula (Sclerocarya birrea) seed oil #8, camellia seed oil #9, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride #12; patchouli/bitter-orange oils are fragrance. notes: The 'oil-led boundary' product: marketed and categorised at dm as Haaröl ('mit 6 Blütenölen') but the INCI is silicone/isododecane-led, with oils from position 4. Fits the Oil category by label/retail category and the Styling/finish_shine category by formula (silicone shine/frizz finish), so Nick's 'oil-free -> Styling, oil-led -> Oil' needs an operational rule (INCI-position threshold vs. product-category label). Product also claims heat protection 230 C (Heat Protectant overlap). A sister product, Elvital Öl Magique Midnight Serum (dm 1333706), is called a 'Haaröl' in the text but is a water/cetearyl-alcohol emulsion with coconut oil at #3 - not recorded here.
